description: Schema for validating GCP function configurations (v1)

functions.description: List of functions to be deployed

allOf.errorMessage: Each function must specify either 'trigger_http' or 'event_trigger', but not both

available_memory.description: Memory allocated to the function, e.g., '128Mi' for 128 MB
available_memory.errorMessage: 'available_memory' must be a string specifying memory (e.g., '128Mi') if provided or must be omitted

build_environment_variables.description: Build environment variables for the function, defined as key-value pairs
build_environment_variables.errorMessage: 'build_environment_variables' must be an object with key-value pairs if provided or must be omitted

description.errorMessage: 'description' property must be a string if provided or must be omitted

entry_point.description: Entry point for the function (e.g., main function to execute)
entry_point.errorMessage: 'entry_point' is required and must be a string representing the main function entry point

environment_variables.description: Build environment variables for the function, defined as key-value pairs
environment_variables.errorMessage: 'environment_variables' must be an object with key-value pairs of strings, integers, or booleans if provided or must be omitted

event_trigger.description: Event trigger configuration for the function. Used when the function is triggered by an event
event_trigger.errorMessage: 'event_trigger' must include 'event_type' and 'resource' properties if provided or must be omitted

event_type.description: Type of event that triggers the function, e.g., 'google.storage.object.finalize'
event_type.errorMessage: 'event_type' must be a string specifying the event type

retry.description: If true, retries event processing upon failure
retry.errorMessage: 'retry' must be a boolean indicating whether to retry on failure

resource.description: Resource identifier for the event, such as a bucket name for storage events
resource.errorMessage: 'resource' must be a string specifying the resource identifier

ingress_settings.description: Ingress settings to control traffic access to the function
ingress_settings.errorMessage: 'ingress_settings' must be one of 'ALLOW_ALL', 'ALLOW_INTERNAL_ONLY' or 'ALLOW_INTERNAL_AND_GCLB' if provided or must be omitted

labels.description: Labels for the function, defined as key-value pairs for metadata
labels.errorMessage: 'labels' must be an object with key-value pairs if provided or must be omitted

max_instances.description: Maximum number of instances allowed for the function
max_instances.errorMessage: 'max_instances' must be an integer if provided or must be omitted

min_instances.description: Minimum number of instances to keep warm for the function
min_instances.errorMessage: 'min_instances' must be an integer if provided or must be omitted

name.errorMessage: 'name' is a required property and must be a string representing the function's name

runtime.description: Runtime environment for the function, e.g., python38
runtime.errorMessage: 'runtime' is required and must specify the function's runtime as a string

secret_environment_variables.description: Secret environment variables for the function, defined as an array of secrets
secret_environment_variables.errorMessage: 'secret_environment_variables' must be a non-empty array of objects if provided or must be omitted

items.errorMessage: Each object in 'secret_environment_variables' must include 'key', 'secret', and 'version'

key.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the secret
key.errorMessage: 'key' property is required and must be a string

secret.description: Name of the secret resource to retrieve
secret.errorMessage: 'secret' property is required and must be a string

version.description: Version of the secret to use, e.g., 'latest' or a numeric version string
version.errorMessage: 'version' is required and must be either 'latest' or a numeric string

source_folder.description: Relative path to the folder containing function code
source_folder.errorMessage: 'source_folder' is a required property and must be a string specifying the function's source folder

timeout.description: Execution timeout for the function in seconds
timeout.errorMessage: 'timeout' must be an integer if provided or must be omitted

trigger_http.description: If true, the function is triggered by an HTTP request
trigger_http.errorMessage: 'trigger_http' must be a boolean indicating if the function is HTTP-triggered or must be omitted

version.description: Version of the function configuration. Must be 1 for this schema
version.errorMessage: 'version' is a required property and must be set to 1 or 2

vpc_connector.description: VPC connector to use, if applicable
vpc_connector.errorMessage: 'vpc_connector' must be a string if provided or must be omitted

vpc_connector_egress_settings.description: Egress settings for the VPC connector
vpc_connector_egress_settings.errorMessage: 'vpc_connector_egress_settings' must be one of 'PRIVATE_RANGES_ONLY' or 'ALL_TRAFFIC' if provided or must be omitted
